stages.title: Life cycle

leads.idea: Why the product is worth building: the vision, what is known and kept from conversations, the beliefs waiting on their tests.
leads.requirements: What the product must do, as its user sees it: the stories, the use cases and the requirements they grew into.
leads.design: How the system will do it: the architecture views, the decisions taken and the design notes written before code.
leads.build: What is being built and where it stands: the code repositories and the product tasks, grouped by feature, read from the tracker.
leads.verify: What was accepted and how it was proven: the stage acceptance records with their revisions and checks.
leads.release: What reached its users and when: the release records ship-release writes — the notes and the versions.
leads.operate: What failed in use and what it changed: the incident records handle-incident holds — the timeline, the cost, what was filed.
